facts.fact: The document says the World Bank-financed WURI-Togo project aims to give every resident a unique identification number (NIU) from biographic and biometric data, with mass biometric enrolment launched in Savanes region in November 2024 and Kara region the last stage, about to start.

TGO.note: The workshop was on a project's implementation and grievance committees, not a named digital law or policy.
